interface.signature: def isMatch(s: str, p: str) -> bool:

preconditions.description: Both s and p must be strings.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c in '?*' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s contains only lowercase letters a-z.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c in '?*' for c in p)
preconditions.description: Pattern p contains only lowercase letters a-z, '?', or '*'.

postconditions.description: The return value is true if and only if the pattern p matches the entire string s according to wildcard rules: '?' matches any single character, '*' matches any sequence (including empty), and the match must cover the entire string.
